trial_court: Addl. Principal Judge, Family Court, Patna (Matrimonial Case No. 242 of 2004)
facts_of_case: Marriage between Rajiv Roshan and Sarika was solemnized in 1997. They have two sons. The husband sought divorce on the ground of cruelty. The trial court decreed divorce with direction to pay permanent alimony.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the wife to establish that she has been treated with cruelty by her husband.
legal_principles.held: The act of the wife leaving the matrimonial house in the night and did not take any legal step for custody of her two sons since 2004 shows her lack of love and affection towards her children, who were very small at that time, and also her behaviour was cruel towards her husband.

legal_principles.principle: A wife's departure from the matrimonial home without taking any legal step for custody of her children may be considered as a factor in establishing cruelty.
legal_principles.held: The act of the wife leaving the matrimonial house in the night and did not take any legal step for custody of her two sons since 2004 shows her lack of love and affection towards her children, who were very small at that time, and also her behaviour was cruel towards her husband.

outcome.final_order: Divorce granted, husband directed to pay Rs. 6,000/- per month as permanent alimony to the wife till her remarriage.
